text: Archivists at the Velnor County Records Office said Tuesday that the newly catalogued Voskresen manuscript was written in Old Church Slavonic, ending weeks of speculation over its origin. The parchment, found last month in a sealed chest during repairs at St. Brannoc’s Chapel in Lethwy, is believed to date to the late 11th century and contains hymns, marginal notes and a partial calendar of feast days. Curator Elin Marr said conservation staff used spectral imaging and comparative linguistics to identify the language. “The evidence is now clear: this text is Old Church Slavonic,” Marr said. The manuscript, about 48 pages long, will be transferred to climate-controlled storage while researchers prepare a public exhibit later this year.
